items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Yeah, Johnny Lindsey. Yeah. I'll tell the truth but I don't know him much.

ctx.x: Joe. Joe Lindsey. Johnny was the bass player.

Yeah, Johnny Lindsey. Yeah. I'll tell the truth but I don't know him much. You never knew? No, no. See I left there, see I left New Orleans in 1918. 1918 is when you went to show up. Yeah, so I don't know much about those stuff at all. I didn't even know George Rush till I met him on here. No, that's right. He was younger, he came up later. No, I didn't know anything about him. He didn't come up until 1920s. I think he had a little fella, I think what you call him, he played piano with him a while, Steve Lewis.…
Yeah, they always talked about Steve Lewis and this Johnny you talking about, the drummer
